correctness.rationale: Preassigned killed trajectories give directed root reachability and exact forbidden-set avoidance Q_s=(1+mu*s/(n-1))^-1. Target indegree-zero factorial moments for k vertices are (n-1)_k Q_(k-1)^k Q_k^(n-k), or exponent n-k-1 on excluding root arcs, then uniform small-k estimates with truncated inclusion-exclusion give Poisson law to o(mu^-2). After a first jump the active population is at least two; supermartingale rho^a with rho=2(1-p)/p bounds extinction before n/2 discoveries by O(mu^-2). A union bound for internally connected but externally inaccessible subsets s<=n/2 is O(mu/n), so unvisited and indegree-zero counts couple. The root no-jump event is independent of root-excluded indegree-zero variable and has exact probability q. Independent rational absorbing-recursion versus closed-reachable-set recursion passed n=2..8 for several rational p. The mathematical proof contains analytic estimates for all large n, not inferred from finite tests.

value.rationale: A sharp first-order refinement of a natural frog/epidemic coverage limit: isolates the exact q~1/log n mass at macroscopic early extinction from late isolated-vertex Poisson fluctuations. Quantitative coefficient and coverage correction matter because earlier general results stated only order bounds.

final_claim: For one initially active root frog on loopless K_n with geometric mean lifetime mu=log n+c, fixed c, unvisited count law differs from (1-q)Poisson(e^-c)+q delta_(n-1) by O_c(mu^-2), q=1/(1+mu); hence TV to Poisson=q+O(mu^-2) and coverage (1-q)exp(-e^-c)+O(mu^-2).
limitations: Fixed real c, one root awake, geometric lifetime and uniform loopless K_n only.
Claim is not a generic universal epidemic Poisson correction.
residual_risks: Broader epidemic theory may contain higher-accuracy mixture approximation with exact leading coefficient.
Large-n union-bound uniformity was checked analytically as stated; independent small n checks alone cannot certify rate.
